name: Kaido
summary: Investigative intelligence search that queries 15+ breach, social OSINT and network data providers from one place.
description: A login-walled search tool that runs a query across 15+ integrated intelligence providers grouped into breach databases (LeakCheck, Snusbase, HIBP, AntiPublic), social OSINT (Discord, TikTok, LinkedIn) and network sources (Shodan, IP tools, infrastructure). The public page is a one-screen landing with the provider list; everything else sits behind the sign-in.
contains: provider groups: breach databases, social OSINT, network and infrastructure
providers include HIBP, Snusbase, Shodan, LeakCheck, IntelX and SubFinder
login required; the only public link is /login
